# Levi Palacios

> Software developer at WeSpark (El Salvador) specializing in AI automation, Bitcoin infrastructure, and interactive learning technology.

## About
Levi Palacios is a Junior Developer at WeSpark, El Salvador's innovation agency, where he builds AI automation systems, intelligent workflow pipelines, and interactive visual learning tools. He has specialized hands-on experience with Bitcoin second-layer systems including the Lightning Network and Liquid Network, developed through intensive bootcamps with Cubo+ Devs and the Blockstream ecosystem. He is also pursuing formal studies in Computer Engineering. His work philosophy centers on making advanced technology understandable, interactive, and usable for everyday people.

## Work
- Junior Developer, AI Automations & Visual Learning — WeSpark, El Salvador (Current) — https://www.wespark.io
- Bitcoin Developer Training — Cubo+ Devs / Blockstream Ecosystem (Technical Formation)
- Computer Engineering — Formal Studies (In Progress)

## Focus Areas
- AI Automation: automation architecture, workflow logic design, intelligent interfaces
- Bitcoin Infrastructure: Lightning Network, Liquid Network, Nostr, blockchain education tools
- Interactive Learning: gamified interfaces, visual simulations, EdTech products
